title: inference-benchmark-design
summary: How to design a benchmark for inference serving that produces trustworthy, actionable results. Covers workload regime selection, SLO-aware metrics, trace replay, multi-seed evaluation, inconclusive handling, and the common mistakes that invalidate benchmark results. Drawn from vllm-evolve and InferRSI's evidence framework.
